persuade.name: Persuade
persuade.description: Verbally convince a listener who can hear you to adopt a certain belief or course of action.

coordinate.name: Coordinate
coordinate.description: Direct allies who can hear you to act in a synchronized or tactical manner.

unarmedAttack.name: Unarmed Attack
unarmedAttack.description: Strike an enemy in the same hex or adjacent square using only your body while unarmed.

meleeAttack.name: Melee Attack
meleeAttack.description: Strike an enemy in the same hex or adjacent square with a handheld melee weapon.

rangedAttack.name: Ranged Attack
rangedAttack.description: Fire a ranged weapon at a target.

sniperAim.name: Sniper Aim
sniperAim.description: Carefully aim a weapon equipped with an optical sight to make a precise, long-range shot.

grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.description: Attempt to seize and physically restrain an enemy in the same hex or adjacent square while unarmed.

breakFree.name: Break Free
breakFree.description: Attempt to escape from a grapple while you are grappled.

standGuard.name: Stand Guard
standGuard.description: Hold a position and watch for enemy activity when an enemy is in the same hex or adjacent square.

clearJam.name: Clear Jam
clearJam.description: Spend time fixing a malfunctioning or stuck weapon.

shootBow.name: Shoot Bow
shootBow.description: Fire an arrow or bolt from a bow or crossbow.

throwWeapon.name: Throw Weapon
throwWeapon.description: Hurl a thrown weapon or hand grenade at a target.

aimHeavyWeapon.name: Aim Heavy Weapon
aimHeavyWeapon.description: Steady and aim a heavy weapon before firing.

fireHeavyWeapon.name: Fire Heavy Weapon
fireHeavyWeapon.description: Discharge a heavy weapon at a target.

directIndirectFire.name: Direct Indirect Fire
directIndirectFire.description: Guide indirect fire onto a target you can see.

firstAid.name: First Aid
firstAid.description: Provide emergency medical treatment to a victim incapacitated by wounds.

rally.name: Rally
rally.description: Attempt to restore composure to a victim incapacitated by stress.

enterOrExitVehicle.name: Enter or Exit Vehicle
enterOrExitVehicle.description: Get into or out of a vehicle.

getItemFromBackpack.name: Get Item from Backpack
getItemFromBackpack.description: Retrieve a stowed item from your backpack.

hide.name: Hide
hide.description: Conceal yourself using cover, concealment, or darkness.

seekCover.name: Seek Cover
seekCover.description: Move to terrain providing cover to gain protection from enemy fire.

fullToPartialCover.name: Full to Partial Cover
fullToPartialCover.description: Leave full protection to take a position of partial protection.

run.name: Run
run.description: Sprint a short distance to reposition when no enemy is in the same hex or adjacent square.

crossLowBarrier.name: Cross Low Barrier
crossLowBarrier.description: Quickly move over a low obstacle.

moveThroughDoor.name: Move Through Door
moveThroughDoor.description: Open and pass through a closed door.

crawl.name: Crawl
crawl.description: Move a short distance while prone.

getUp.name: Get Up
getUp.description: Rise from a prone position to standing.

drawFromCombatGear.name: Draw from Combat Gear
drawFromCombatGear.description: Quickly retrieve a readily accessible item from your combat gear.

shove.name: Shove
shove.description: Push an enemy in the same hex or adjacent square to knock them off balance or move them.

disarm.name: Disarm
disarm.description: Attempt to knock an item from the grasp of a target who holds one.

grappleAttack.name: Grapple Attack
grappleAttack.description: Make a quick attack against an opponent you are already grappling.

retreat.name: Retreat
retreat.description: Carefully back away from an enemy in the same hex or adjacent square.

aim.name: Aim
aim.description: Quickly align a ranged weapon on a target.

prepareBow.name: Prepare Bow
prepareBow.description: Nock an arrow or load a bolt into a bow.

assumeOverwatch.name: Assume Overwatch Position
assumeOverwatch.description: Ready a ranged weapon to fire at a target entering your field of fire.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Swap out a magazine or otherwise reload a ranged weapon, which becomes a slow action if failed.

activateExplosive.name: Activate Explosive
activateExplosive.description: Prime and trigger a grenade or explosive device.

getOnRide.name: Get on a Bike / Ride
getOnRide.description: Mount a motorcycle, bicycle, or similar ride.

grabTheWheel.name: Grab the Wheel
grabTheWheel.description: Seize control of a vehicle's steering.

drive.name: Drive
drive.description: Operate a vehicle to move it.

useItem.name: Use Item
useItem.description: Activate or employ a miscellaneous item, with effects varying by item.

throwItem.name: Throw Item
throwItem.description: Hurl a miscellaneous item at a target or location, with effects varying by item.

dropBackpack.name: Drop Backpack
dropBackpack.description: Shed a backpack or other bulky item to reduce encumbrance.

readyShield.name: Ready Shield
readyShield.description: Bring a shield to a defensive position when an enemy is in the same hex or adjacent square.

dropToGround.name: Drop to the Ground
dropToGround.description: Immediately fall prone while standing up.

dropHeldItem.name: Drop Held Item
dropHeldItem.description: Release an item from your hand.

partialToFullCover.name: Partial to Full Cover
partialToFullCover.description: Slip fully behind cover from a partially protected position.

shoutWords.name: Shout a Few Words
shoutWords.description: Quickly communicate a short phrase to those who can hear you.

handSignals.name: Hand Signals
handSignals.description: Wordlessly communicate a simple message with gestures.

checkAmmo.name: Check Ammo or Gear
checkAmmo.description: Glance at your equipment to verify its status.

blocking.name: Blocking
blocking.description: Interpose an object or limb to deflect an incoming attack when you have something available to block with.

overwatchFire.name: Overwatch Fire
overwatchFire.description: Fire your readied ranged weapon at a target that enters your field of fire while you are in overwatch.
